description: The job involves managing application security hardening and vulnerability assessments, accessing APIs to ensure secure integration, and overseeing the security of deployed applications and solutions. The role focuses on monitoring for potential breaches and compromises, implementing security measures, and maintaining robust defenses against evolving cybersecurity threats.
